## Longitudinal Data

### Load longitudinal data
```{r}
long_741 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("RawData", "dataset_741_long_06-07-2022.xlsx"))
long_742 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("RawData", "dataset_742_long_06-07-2022.xlsx"))
long_1057<-readxl::read_xlsx(here("RawData", "dataset_1057_long_07-11-2022.xlsx"))
dataset_long <- full_join(long_741,long_742,long_1057,by=c("projid","fu_year","study")) 

# Fill in missing values
dataset_long <- dataset_long %>% 
  group_by(projid) %>%
  fill(colnames(dataset_long), .direction = "downup")
dim(dataset_long) #31058 214
```

### Load motor data

```{r}
# raw motor data: fill up the missing value
motor_data<-readxl::read_xlsx(here("RawData", "motor_1057_long_07-11-2022.xlsx"))
motor_data <- motor_data %>% 
  arrange(projid, fu_year) %>% 
  group_by(projid) %>%
  fill(gait_speed, motor10, motor_dexterity, 
       motor_gait, motor_handstreng, bradysc, 
       gaitsc, parksc, rigidsc, tremsc, .direction = "downup")
dim(motor_data) # 31135 14
```

### Load sleep data
```{r}
sleep_data<-readxl::read_xlsx(here("RawData", "Sleep Variables 07-2022.xlsx"))
sleep_data <- sleep_data %>% 
  mutate(fu_year = as.numeric(visit)) %>% 
  arrange(projid, fu_year) %>% 
  group_by(projid) %>%
  fill(q1slp, q2slp, q4slp, q5slp, .direction = "downup")
dim(sleep_data) 
```

### Merge all types of data
```{r}
dataset_long_with_motor <- inner_join(dataset_long, 
                                      motor_data, 
                                      by = c("projid", "fu_year", "study"))
dim(dataset_long_with_motor) #31058 225

dataset_long_with_motor_sleep <- inner_join(dataset_long_with_motor, 
                                            sleep_data, 
                                            by = c("projid", "fu_year"))

dim(dataset_long_with_motor_sleep) # 29309   230
```

## Cross-sectional Data

### Load data
```{r}
basic_741 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("RawData",
                                    "dataset_741_basic_06-07-2022.xlsx"))
basic_742 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("RawData", 
                                    "dataset_742_basic_06-07-2022.xlsx"))
dataset_basic <- full_join(basic_741,basic_742,by=c("projid","study")) #3724,138
dim(dataset_basic)
```

### Processing cross-sectional data
```{r}
dataset_basic <- dataset_basic %>% 
  mutate(brainwt = as.numeric(brainwt),
         apoe_E2 = case_when(apoe_genotype == 22 ~ 2,
                             apoe_genotype == 23 | apoe_genotype == 24 ~ 1,
                             TRUE ~ 0),
                  apoe_E4 = case_when(apoe_genotype == 44 ~ 2,
                             apoe_genotype == 34 | apoe_genotype == 24 ~ 1,
                             TRUE ~ 0),
         TOMM40_S = case_when(tomm40_hap == 1 ~ 2,
                              tomm40_hap == 2 | tomm40_hap == 3 ~ 1,
                              TRUE ~ 0),
         TOMM40_L = case_when(tomm40_hap == 4 ~ 2,
                              tomm40_hap == 2 | tomm40_hap == 5 ~ 1,
                              TRUE ~ 0),
         TOMM40_VL = case_when(tomm40_hap == 6 ~ 2,
                              tomm40_hap == 3 | tomm40_hap == 5 ~ 1,
                              TRUE ~ 0))
```

```{r}
write.csv(dataset_basic, "dataset_basic.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
dim(dataset_basic)
dataset_basic = dataset_basic %>%
  mutate(gpath = sqrt(gpath),
         tangles = sqrt(tangles),
         amyloid = sqrt(amyloid),
         niareagansc = as.numeric(niareagansc))
dim(dataset_basic)
```



## Merge longitudinal data and cross-sectional data for all subjects (Deleting the following sentence: with all 5 brain pathology measurements)

```{r}
dataset_merged <- merge(dataset_basic, dataset_long_with_motor_sleep,
                        by = c("projid", "study"),
                        sort = FALSE) %>% 
  select(projid, study, fu_year, cogdx, 
         eval(clinic_var_list)) %>% 
  arrange(projid, fu_year)

length(unique(dataset_merged$projid))
dim(dataset_merged) # 61 = 57 + 4 (projid, study, fu_year, cogdx)
write.csv(dataset_merged, "dataset_merged_0825.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

The archived dataset summary recorded 13,014 longitudinal records for 1,562 participants. One participant had pathology measurements but no corresponding longitudinal records; their individual identifier is intentionally omitted.

### Check missing data (after filling in using data from the closest visit)

```{r}
miss_df = data.frame(n.missing = colSums(is.na(dataset_merged))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n.missing)) %>% 
  filter(n.missing > 0)

pander::pander(miss_df)
```

### Fill missing yearly visits for each participant, then keep only cases with complete clinic_var_list values. This order ensures that there are both decedents and living participants. If the order is changed, there will be only decedents.

```{r}
fill_visits_by_years = function(id){
  
  temp_dat = dataset_merged %>% filter(projid == id)
  
  max_visit = max(temp_dat$fu_year)
  
  all_visit = data.frame(projid = id, fu_year = 0:max_visit)
  all_visit  = merge(all_visit, temp_dat, by = c("projid", "fu_year"),
                     all.x = T)
  
  # Fill in missing visits
  all_visit <- all_visit %>% 
    group_by(projid) %>%
    fill(colnames(all_visit), .direction = "downup")

  return(all_visit)
}
```

```{r}
subject_id = unique(dataset_merged$projid)
filled_year_dat = NULL

for (i in 1:length(subject_id)){

  filled_year_dat = rbind(filled_year_dat, fill_visits_by_years(subject_id[i]))
  
}

colnames(filled_year_dat) = colnames(fill_visits_by_years(subject_id[1]))
filled_year_dat = filled_year_dat %>% 
  arrange(projid, fu_year)

dim(filled_year_dat) # 61 = 57 + 4 (projid, study, fu_year, cogdx)
``` 

```{r}
# nocomp.id = filled_year_dat$projid[!complete.cases(filled_year_dat)] %>% unique(.)

# Checking only consider the complete row of clinic_var_list
nocomp.id <- filled_year_dat$projid[!complete.cases(filled_year_dat[ , clinic_var_list])] %>% unique()

full_dataset_merged = filled_year_dat %>% 
  filter(!projid %in% nocomp.id) %>% 
  arrange(projid)

dim(full_dataset_merged)

full_samples = unique(full_dataset_merged[, c('projid', 'study')])
dataset_merged_unique_id = unique(dataset_merged[, c('projid', 'study')])

table(full_samples$study)
table(dataset_merged_unique_id$study) # Used to check what if we do not choose the full_samples case.
```

```{r}
  filter(projid %in% full_dataset_merged$projid) %>% 
  select(projid, study, gpath, tangles, amyloid, niareagansc) %>% 
  arrange(projid)

dim(pathology_dat) # projid, study, gpath, tangles, amyloid, niareagansc # Previously 1214 6

```
